name: Tsubaki Kousuke
source:
Ever since she was little, she thought she was a woman despite being born into a male body. She likes women and has been popular with them ever since she was younger because she could emphasize with their feelings. She would often stand up for them in order to stop their bullies.

She works in interior design and is thinking about starting her own independent business. Although she has a high sense of beauty, she doesn't mind doing dirty work and physical labor. She has the ability to perceive what people want and doesn't overlook women's crises. She's not usually violent, but if necessary, she will use her full strength to beat someone up.

[Translated from [url=https://saya-sp.com/hanasaya_gp_op/layer_if/layer_ifb_character/]official website[/url]]
